justification: Both surfaces depict an anthropomorphic figure in low relief accompanied by curling volute/scroll forms and show a clearly articulated hand, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A shows a sparse, monumental composition of a few large rounded masses spread horizontally with no framing, while B shows a densely packed vertical panel of a standing costumed figure with elaborate headdress, ornament chains and rectangular sign-blocks bordering the field and a patterned band at the base — a very different compositional scheme and degree of detail.
